title: Cooper Creek 20160313_014852 solitary wolf howl very clear
author: betchkal
changes: A wild grey wolf (Canis lupus) howling alone in Wrangell-St. Elias National Park, Alaska: the rising start of one long howl. Trimmed to 1.75–4.67 s of the original, mixed to mono, silence trimmed, loudness-normalised (≈ −18 dBFS RMS, peak ≤ −1 dBFS), 10 ms fade-in / 120 ms fade-out, encoded as 96 kbps mono MP3. Taken from the Freesound high-quality MP3 preview of the recording. The last 0.6 s is faded out because the howl carries on for several more seconds.
